translation_direction: ru → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Russian electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: The Underground Man’s spiteful, self-lacerating, digressive confession is kept in sharp colloquial-literary Vietnamese, with the particle-flavoured sarcasm and abrupt shifts of the original and no softening.
decisions.rationale: The text’s force is its contradiction of cringing and aggression in one sentence.

decisions.decision: The Russian text comes from Wikisource because the backlog’s Open Library entry carries no text; the editorial footnotes in the transcription were removed.
decisions.rationale: Translation is directly from the Russian.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: ‘Прав, что подлец’ was rendered as a tautology, losing the ironic ‘he is in the right’; restored.
‘Помириться на уме’ was read as being satisfied with his own intellect instead of settling for a face that looks intelligent; corrected.
‘В хлопочках’ (in cotton wool) was read as fuss, losing the jewel-in-cotton image; restored as ‘bọc bông’.
The address pronouns of the narrator and Liza switched between tôi/cô and anh/em inconsistently in and around the tirade; one rule applied across units 239–520.
‘Припадок/истерика’ (a fit, hysterics) was rendered ‘cơn lên đồng’ (spirit-possession ritual) in units 476, 478, 494 and 495; now ‘cơn kích động’ or ‘cơn nức nở’.
‘Впрочем’ was always rendered ‘vả lại’; varied naturally.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: Phần I. Dưới hầm · Chương I … Phần II · Chương X
glossary.rationale: Heading units built from the page titles; the part title is added to the first chapter of each part.

glossary.draft_rendering: tôi/cô in the cold scenes and the outburst; anh/em in the sentimental scenes
glossary.rationale: One pair per scene across the book.
The ‘living life’ he says we have forgotten.

witness_decision: Selected the Russian Wikisource transcription of Записки из подполья (Dostoevsky, first printed in Epokha, 1864), fetched chapter by chapter as raw wikitext; the page is not marked as fully proofread, and the text was not collated with the first printing.

unresolved_questions.explanation: The rendering of ‘Воскреситель’ in unit 490 is only approximate.
A short gloss on ‘kukish’ in unit 34 goes beyond the Russian.

title_review.rationale: The title is translated as ‘Ghi chép từ dưới hầm’; no earlier Vietnamese title was checked.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The author’s note: ‘Both the author of the notes and the Notes themselves are, of course, fictitious.’
The last unit: ‘But the notes of this paradoxalist do not end here.’
